ndbaa968fe7.headline: Due to the dollar, input costs for public works rose up to 28% in August
ndbaa968fe7.summary: Input costs for public works in Argentina rose by up to 28% in August, mainly affecting products tied to the US dollar, including steel.
ndbaa968fe7.why: Rising input costs due to currency effects increase infrastructure project expenses, impacting government budgets and construction sector profitability.
